postings.title: Wireless Firmware Engineer (Starlink Mobile)
top_requirements: Design and implement wireless firmware for cellular connectivity on satellite platforms, including low‑level driver development and protocol stack integration.
Perform end‑to‑end RF link budgeting and validation of modem performance in space‑qualified hardware environments.
Develop and execute automated test frameworks for firmware verification on prototype and production units.
postings.summary: Develops and validates the firmware that enables Starlink Mobile’s cellular service from space. The role matches the candidate’s satellite communications and modem design background.

postings.title: Optical Communications Software Engineer - Modem Integration
top_requirements: Integrate optical modem subsystems with MEMS micromirror arrays to achieve high‑bandwidth free‑space links.
Develop and validate signal processing algorithms for coherent optical communication, including DSP chain and error‑correction coding.
Perform hardware‑in‑the‑loop testing of the optical terminal, including link budget analysis and thermal‑vacuum validation.
postings.summary: Works on the software side of BST’s free‑space optical modem, bridging optics and communications. The candidate’s modem and signal‑processing expertise is directly applicable.

postings.title: Modem Test Engineer with Security Clearance
top_requirements: Develop and execute carrier‑acceptance test plans for 4G/5G modem hardware against US carrier specifications.
Automate RF performance measurements (EVM, ACLR, IIP3) using test equipment and custom software scripts.
Analyze test data to identify hardware and firmware issues and drive corrective actions with cross‑functional teams.
bonus_skills: LabVIEW or Python for test automation
postings.summary: Ensures modem compliance with carrier requirements for L&T’s wireless technology projects. The role leverages the candidate’s modem test experience.

postings.title: Lead ASIC Modem Design Engineer, Satellite Communication
top_requirements: Lead ASIC design of satellite communication modem blocks, from RTL coding to tape‑out in a multi‑project wafer flow.
Define and verify hardware specifications against system‑level requirements for Amazon Leo’s LEO network.
Develop high‑volume test methodologies for silicon validation, including automated ATE and on‑board testing.
postings.summary: Leads ASIC modem design for Amazon’s Leo satellite broadband project, a perfect fit for transitioning into senior IC roles.

postings.title: Senior Modem Engineer, Satellite Communication
top_requirements: Translate system‑level modem requirements into RTL specifications and verify using simulation and emulation platforms.
Collaborate with SoC architects to integrate modem IP blocks, ensuring correct interface protocols and timing closure.
Develop and execute silicon validation test plans, including performance, power, and reliability testing.
postings.summary: Senior modem engineer focusing on ASIC integration for Amazon Leo, leveraging the candidate’s modem and system design expertise.

postings.title: 6G Cellular Modem Systems Engineer
top_requirements: Define next‑generation cellular modem architectures for 6G, including novel waveforms and massive MIMO baseband processing.
Lead cross‑functional hardware/software teams to implement high‑speed silicon prototypes and validate performance against emerging standards.
Develop comprehensive test strategies for silicon validation, including RF, digital, and system‑level metrics.
postings.summary: Works on cutting‑edge 6G modem systems at Apple, offering a high‑compensation role that aligns with the candidate’s advanced modem expertise.
